title: due-diligence
description: Lithuanian company due diligence from the state registers, optionally signed by a lawyer.
summary: Lithuanian company due diligence from the state registers, optionally signed by a lawyer.
offersHint: Lithuanian company due diligence from the state registers, optionally signed by a lawyer. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.tvarka.pro/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Tvarka Due Diligence API key>. Sandbox keys answer synthetic data at no cost; production keys follow a signed engagement agreement.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <your Tvarka Due Diligence API key>. Sandbox keys answer synthetic data at no cost; production keys follow a signed engagement agreement.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_company
toolsPreview.description: Core registry profile of a Lithuanian legal entity: name, legal form, status, registered address, registration dates, capital, activities and current management. Real-time from the state register.

toolsPreview.name: get_participants
toolsPreview.description: Current participants (shareholders, members) of a Lithuanian legal entity.

toolsPreview.name: get_beneficial_owners
toolsPreview.description: Declared beneficial owners of a Lithuanian legal entity, with ownership percentages and control basis. Served under the legitimate-interest regime; a purpose is required and is logged.

toolsPreview.name: get_real_estate
toolsPreview.description: Real property registered to a Lithuanian legal entity, with the rights recorded on each object. Legal entities only.

toolsPreview.name: get_seizures
toolsPreview.description: Property seizure acts registered against a Lithuanian legal entity, with the institution that imposed them, the parties and the seized assets. An entity with no acts is a clean record, not a missing answer.

toolsPreview.name: get_court_cases
toolsPreview.description: Court hearings where the Lithuanian legal entity appears as a party.

toolsPreview.name: get_due_diligence_report
toolsPreview.description: One call returning the whole picture: profile, participants, beneficial owners, real property, seizure acts and court cases. Cheaper than the parts bought separately. A purpose is required because the report contains beneficial-owner data.
